# Microsoft Support

> > Official support hub for Microsoft products including Windows 11/10, Microsoft 365, Office applications, OneDrive, Copilot AI, and Microsoft account services.

This site provides comprehensive help documentation, troubleshooting guides, and customer support resources for all Microsoft products and services. Users can access product-specific support hubs, contact information, and step-by-step tutorials for common tasks and issues.

## Key Topics

- Windows 11
- Windows 10
- Microsoft 365
- Microsoft account
- Office applications (Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, OneNote, Access)
- OneDrive
- Copilot AI
- Windows Update
- Troubleshooting
- Account management
- Windows activation
- Customer support options
- Small business support
- Skype and Teams migration

## Main Support Hubs

- [Microsoft Support](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us): Main support hub for Microsoft products including 365, Windows, Surface
- [All Products](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/all-products): Complete directory of Microsoft products and their support resources
- [Windows help and learning](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows): Windows support hub for installation, updates, security, and AI features
- [Welcome To Windows](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/welcometowindows): Windows 11 welcome hub covering upgrades, FAQs, and device lifecycles
- [Skype help & learning](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/skype): Skype support hub covering retirement, Teams migration, and data export

## Customer Support & Contact

- [Contact Us - Microsoft Support](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/contactus): Contact options for Microsoft Support agents and common problem solutions
- [Customer service phone numbers - Microsoft Support](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/topic/customer-service-phone-numbers-c0389ade-5640-e588-8b0e-28de8afeb3f2): Support phone numbers for business users and links for home users
- [Get help with your Microsoft account - Microsoft Support](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/account-billing/get-help-with-your-microsoft-account-ace6f3b3-e2d3-aeb1-6b96-d2e9e7e52133): Microsoft account help for sign-in, security, and dashboard management
- [Microsoft 365 Customer Service and Support - Microsoft Support](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/microsoft-365-customer-service-and-support-96162163-b3aa-498b-bbbb-5e757b0f31da): Microsoft 365 support policy for home and business subscription plans

## Windows Troubleshooting & Maintenance

- [Install Windows Updates - Microsoft Support](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/install-windows-updates-3c5ae7fc-9fb6-9af1-1984-b5e0412c556a): Guide to checking and installing Windows Updates for security and stability
- [Using System File Checker in Windows - Microsoft Support](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/using-system-file-checker-in-windows-365e0031-36b1-6031-f804-8fd86e0ef4ca): How to run SFC scan to check and repair corrupted Windows system files
- [Recovery Drive - Microsoft Support](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/recovery-drive-abb4691b-5324-6d4a-8766-73fab304c246): Create USB recovery drive for Windows reinstallation after hardware failure
- [How to get help in Windows - Microsoft Support](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/how-to-get-help-in-windows-711b6492-0435-0038-8706-7c6b0feb200a): Guide to accessing Windows help through taskbar, Tips app, and Settings
- [Uninstall or remove apps and programs in Windows - Microsoft Support](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/uninstall-or-remove-apps-and-programs-in-windows-4b55f974-2cc6-2d2b-d092-5905080eaf98): How to uninstall apps and programs using Settings or Control Panel
